question.text: Electrolytic reduction of alumina to aluminium by Hall-Heroult process is carried out

options.text: in presence of cryolite which forms a melt with lower melting temperature
in the presence of cryolite which forms a melt with higher melting temperature

solution.text: Cryolite is used to lower the meeting point of alumina <math><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>)</mo></math> as well as to make it good conductor of electric current.
